title: A range edge below the corridor
why: Rule 4 at the lower edge: MCD2 is a flat range with the price below its lower edge, so both trader types get a LONG (archetype D). The trend relation is COUNTER_TREND by decision D1 (d) even though MCD1 is an uptrend and the LONG agrees with it; that is how the draft table reads and Section 6 uses the relation for the style notice and the 2.50 times cap. MCD3 sees a trend conflict (M15 up, M5 flat), so both readings are CAUTIONARY. The price is below the whole M5 channel, so there are no zones.
